blurb: The perfect haven for outdoor enthusiasts looking to get away from the cosmopolitan bustle of Dallas-Fort Worth, Silver Lake Marina rests in a peaceful cove along the gently rolling shores of Lake Grapevine. Combining a laidback atmosphere, access to 30 acres of lakefront park property, and the allure of adventure on the water, this lakeside destination is an idyllic escape for any DFW
